# Duke Nukem 3D (3D Realms, 1996) game palette (PALETTE.DAT), 6-bit DAC values.
# One "r g b" per line, entries 0-255 in order.
# Source: SLADE, dist/res/palettes/"Duke Nukem .pal" (GPL); 8-bit to 6-bit
# with v >> 2.
# Entry 255 (magenta, 255 0 255 in 8 bits) is the transparency key of the ART
# tiles, never drawn; it is replaced by black here.
# https://github.com/sirjuddington/SLADE/tree/master/dist/res/palettes
